{{Short description|German physicist}}
[[File:Axel freimuth 20071128.jpg|right|thumb|Axel Freimuth in 2007]]
'''Axel Freimuth''' (born 27 October 1957) is a German physicist. On 1 April 2005 he succeeded the mathematician [[:de: Tassilo Küpper|Tassilo Küpper]] as [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] of [[University of Cologne]]. His initial appointment was for a term of four years but this has subsequently been extended.<ref name=AFlautBO>{{cite web|url=http://www.business-on.de/koeln-bonn/prof-dr-axel-freimuth-_id15515.html|date=7 January 2009| title=Prof. Dr. Axel Freimuth vom Senat als Rektor bestätigt|publisher=Christian Weis GmbH (Business-on.de), Engelskirchen |accessdate=19 May 2018}}</ref><ref name=AFlautExp>{{cite web| title=Kölner Uni-Rektor im Köln-Gespräch| author1=Inge Wozelka| author2=Vanesa Borbas| date=20 April 2015|url= https://www.express.de/koeln/koelner-uni-rektor-im-koeln-gespraech-prof--dr--axel-freimuth---ich-war-kein-guter-schueler--1327816|publisher=DuMont.next GmbH & Co. KG (Express), Köln |accessdate=19 May 2018}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Freimuth was born in [[Duisburg]].<ref name=AFlautUniKoe>{{cite web|url=https://www.portal.uni-koeln.de/rektor.html|title=Univ.-Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Axel Freimuth|publisher=Universität zu Köln|accessdate=19 May 2018}}</ref> He studied physics at the [[University of Cologne]], receiving his doctorate and 1989 and his post-doctoral [[habilitation]] in 1994. His dissertations were titled as follows:  
* 1989 Über die Transporteigenschaften valenzinstabiler Verbindungen<!---if anyone who sufficiently understands physics knows what that would be in English please supply a traslation.   please...--->
* 1994 Transporteigenschaften im gemischten Zustand der Hochtemperatur-Supraleiter<!---if anyone who sufficiently understands physics knows what that would be in English please supply a traslation.   please...--->
While a student he also took work as a supply teacher at the [[:de:Gesamtschule|comprehensive school]] in [[:de:Chorweiler|Cologne-Chorweiler]] and further supplemented his income by working as a truck driver, although in a later interview he insisted that during those years he never lost sight of his core academic goals.<ref name=AFlautExp/>

== Career ==
In 1996 Freimuth accepted an invitation to transfer to [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology|Karlsruhe (KIT)]] as a professor of physics at the university Physics Institute.<ref name=KnachKHuzur>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-protokolle.de/nachrichten/id/45362/|title=Professor Dr. Axel Freimuth, bisher Universität Karlsruhe, ist zum Universitätsprofessor C 4 für Materialphysik am II. Physikalischen Institut der Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftlichen Fakultät ernannt worden. Gleichzeitig ist er ...|date=19 November 1998|publisher=Universität zu Köln|work=Neue Professorinnen und Professoren an der Universität zu Köln|accessdate=19 May 2018|archive-date=19 January 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050119151947/http://www.uni-protokolle.de/nachrichten/id/45362/|url-status=dead}}</ref> However, in 1998 he was tempted back to [[University of Cologne|Cologne]], accepting a "C-4 professorship" in experimental solid state physics.<ref name=AFlautBO/> His principal areas of research within the field of [[solid state physics]] include [[superconductivity]], [[magnetism]] and [[Electronic correlation|electronic strongly correlated matter]].<ref name=KnachKHuzur/>

Freimuth was chair of the University Physics Group between April 2000 and 2003.<ref name=AFlautUniKoe/> In 2002 he undertook a research stay at the [[University of British Columbia]]<ref name=AFlautUniKoe/>  in [[Vancouver]].<ref name=AFlautHN>{{cite web|title=Senat bestätigt Rektor Professor Dr. Axel Freimuth |publisher=Hochschulnachrichten, Bad Homburg|url=http://www.hochschulnachrichten.com/Senat-bestaetigt-Rektor-Professor-Dr--Axel-Freimuth_153.aspx|accessdate=19 May 2018}}</ref>

In 2003 he became [[Dean (education)|dean]] of the Faculty for Mathematics and Natural Sciences at [[University of Cologne|Cologne]], and in April 2005 he became the university's [[:de:Liste der Rektoren der Universität zu Köln|forty-ninth rector]] since 1919.<ref name=AFlautBO/><ref name=UniKoePerli>{{cite web|title=Universität zu Köln|url=http://perlistige.com/article/universitt-zu-kln|publisher=PerliStige|accessdate=21 May 2018}}</ref>  At the end of 2005 he was invited to take on the leadership of the prestigious [[Forschungszentrum Jülich|Jülich Research Centre]] but turned down the invitation in order to renew his contract for the rectorship at Cologne where he has become the longest serving university rector in more than a century.   He served between 2008 and 2010 as chair of the [[:de:Landesrektorenkonferenz|regional rectors' conference]] and of the Cologne Sciences Forum (''"Kölner Wissenschaftsrunde"'').   He also involved himself with the [[Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft|German Physics Society (''"Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft"'' / DPG)]] and in committees of the [[Munich]]-based [[Max Planck Society]].<ref name=AFlautUniKoe/>

== Recognition ==
In 2014 Freimuth came second in the election for "University rector of the year", organised by the [[:de:Deutscher Hochschulverband|University Teachers' Association (''"Deutscher Hochschulverband"'' / DHV)]], beaten to top position by second time winner [[Lambert T. Koch]] of [[University of Wuppertal|Wuppertal]].<ref name=RektordesJahres2014>{{cite web|title=Professor Dr. Lambert Koch ist "Rektor des Jahres"|date=17 February 2014| accessdate=21 May 2018| publisher=Deutscher Hochschulverband, Bonn|url=https://www.hochschulverband.de/pressemitteilung.html?&cHash=65dabc3ee6b4b768834ee0f3d6c5c891&tx_ttnews%5Btt_news%5D=176#_|work=Pressemitteilung ... Deutsche Wissenschaftler geben Rektoren und Präsidenten als Note eine Drei Plus}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Asked about his hobbies, Freimuth disclosed that he tries to find half an hour to play the guitar each evening, sometimes playing along to film music on the television. He also likes to cook. He went on to indicate, however, that his family are less than enthusiastic about his guitar playing, and the cooking loses its appeal when he is dieting.<ref name=AFlautExp/>
